leo: Kicking off POC for client migrating from RivalAI. They want a drop-in experience but worried about prompt parity and billing differences. Can we run a short smoke that compares responses and cost for their top 50 prompts?

maria: Yep — happy to lead the parity tests. Need the prompt list and example headers. Also, do we have a mapping for RivalAI params -> Redwood params?

leo: Sharing prompt set in the doc: https://redwood.example.com/presales/acme/prompt-set (private link). RivalAI uses `model=rival-max`, `max_tokens`, `stop`. They rely on `response_format` for structured output.

maria: For structured output we support function-style / structured output. Quick mapping example below:

```bash
# RivalAI -> Redwood mapping (example)
# rival: model=rival-max, Redwood: model=redwood-large-v1
# rival: response_format=JSON, Redwood: content_format=structured_json
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","prompt":"{{prompt}}","max_tokens":512,"content_format":"structured_json"}'
```

maria: I can run a side-by-side smoke for first 50 prompts and attach a diff of tokens + normalized similarity score.

tim: For staging network, you need these egress IPs: 34.82.45.10, 34.82.45.11. We'll spin a sandbox Dedicated node for throughput parity testing. ETA ~ TOMORROW EOD.

anya: Sales asked about pricing impact at 500M tokens/mo. For hosted: base + per-token. I can run a model mix cost estimate if we assume they will use redwood-large-v1 80% and redwood-mid 20%.

leo: Yes please, @anya, include both hosted and Dedicated ballpark. Also they asked about response deltas for edge-case prompts (legal/regulatory language). Need regression tests for hallucination rate.

security-bot: Automated check: client has submitted initial security questionnaire v1.0. Missing items: encryption-at-rest details, SOC2 scoping doc, KMS integration diagram. Upload path: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qna/acme

rachel-legal: Heads-up — if they require vendor indemnities for hallucination harm we need to escalate. Also confirm data retention and deletion timelines in the SOW.

maria: Plan proposal: 1) run 50-prompt parity smoke, 2) run 200-prompt regression on legal prompts, 3) token-cost estimate for two deployment options, 4) deliver security answers + staged Dedicated for perf. Can we get prompt set + security questionnaire by EOD?

leo: I'll nudge the buyer now. @tim can you reserve a 2-GPU sandbox and share creds for the smoke run?

tim: Reserved: sandbox-dk-02 (2xA10G). I'll DM credentials and open firewall for their test IPs.

anya: I'll draft the hosted vs Dedicated cost scenarios and include notes on batching/query rate controls to reduce per-token cost.

maria: I'll start with a small script to normalize RivalAI outputs and compute token delta + BLEU/ROUGE-ish similarity. Example snippet below:


leo: Awesome. If we can get the smoke comparison and a single-page security summary by Wed, this keeps the deal in the buying window. :thumbsup:

rachel-legal: I'll review the security answers once uploaded and flag any contract edits.

maria: One more thing — RivalAI has a `nucleus_sampling` param by default. We should capture sampling settings so output variance is comparable. I'll add deterministic seed tests.

leo: Great. I'll update the presales playbook with assigned owners. Thanks everyone — I'll post buyer updates here.

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: Upload sec-qna answers within 72h to avoid hold from client security team.
